claim.ja: smooth semipositiveな反標準束の任意線形化Pについて、-Mが擬有効で非有界次数のM+iPに不変切断があれば正のmPに不変切断がある。自然指数とmonodromyから一般のsmooth非消滅を導く。
claim.en: For any linearization P of a smoothly semipositive anticanonical line, unbounded invariant sections of M+iP with -M pseudoeffective give an invariant section of some positive mP. The natural index and monodromy yield ordinary smooth nonvanishing.

role.en: A common invariant ratio field, a continuous maximum metric and a singular degree-zero integral remove the error using a fixed, possibly nontrivial multiplier ideal. An independent harmonic mechanism proves higher-direct-image vanishing from a kernel condition.
